description: Electric Vehicles in Ontario – By Forward Sortation Area is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. This dataset details the total number of electric vehicles (EVs) in Ontario. This includes both battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs). Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Electric Vehicle, EV, BEH, PHEV, Hybrid. It offers 21 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
